Conversation
roots.value: What should I plant in my raised beds this autumn? I'm in zone 8b.

roots.name: Conversation
roots.value: In zone 8b you can still plant spinach, kale and radishes through October. Sow radishes 3 cm apart and thin them to 5 cm once they sprout. Spinach prefers cool soil, so sow it in a lightly shaded corner and keep the bed evenly moist. Kale tolerates frost and gets sweeter after the first cold nights.

roots.name: Conversation
roots.value: Start tomato seedlings indoors in February and plant tomatoes 60 cm apart once the last frost has passed. Stake them at planting time. Choose a sunny bed with at least eight hours of direct light, and mix compost into the soil a few weeks beforehand so the roots find plenty of nutrients when they go in.

roots.name: Conversation
roots.value: How do I protect the beds over winter?

roots.name: Conversation
roots.value: Cover bare soil with 5 cm of straw mulch so rain does not compact it. A layer of leaves works too, but straw is lighter and lets the soil breathe. Water the beds once before mulching so the moisture is locked in underneath.
